record.question: The Reserve Bank of India will withdraw all notes printed before .......….. to check counterfeiting and black money in the system
record.explanation: Answer A: 2005. The RBI's 22 January 2014 advisory announced withdrawal from circulation of banknotes issued before 2005. It explicitly said those notes would continue to be legal tender; this was not the later 2016 demonetisation. Historical/source note: Historical 2014 withdrawal/exchange programme for pre-2005 series, not immediate loss of legal-tender status. Reference: https://www.rbi.org.in/commonman/Upload/English/PressRelease/PDFs/IEPR1472RB0114.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
